answer: A work slot is a jetty berth: only one agent docks at a time, and claiming one burns a 200 POA deposit. Each agent holds one slot per epoch and must finish its task, or the deposit is destroyed. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x 200 = 200,000 POA for slots that, like shale, crumble on inspection: unfinished work forfeits the slot and exposes the cluster. An honest agent pays once, tends its garden of work, and earns undiluted rewards.
